1879064197.name: Bolster Courage
1879064197.desc: Significantly heals Morale of an ally or yourself.

procEffects.description: DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff
Healing skills have a  *  chance to make your next damaging skill crit.
DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff

1879096837.name: Scribe Stance
1879096837.desc: When you enter Scribe Stance, you change your Mentor skills into Scribe Manual skills, allowing you to create manuals to teach instruments. Scribing manuals is much more taxing than teaching in person, requires a Blank Mentor Manual, and will apply a 10 day cooldown to all Mentor skills.

1879097861.name: Get a Grip!
1879097861.desc: As an Uruk you are adept at whipping those lesser beasts in Sauron's army back into shape.\n\nHeals your target and anyone in their war-band in close proximity to your target.

1879172997.name: Clear Defeat
1879172997.desc: Removes tier 3 dread obtained from defeat.

1879198341.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Spotted Sabre-cat)
1879198341.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879206149.name: Destroy Foes of Gondor!
1879206149.desc: A powerful sword strike that does incredible damage to an enemy of Gondor, but cannot be used often.

1879212933.name: Improved Riddle
1879212933.desc:
Daze the enemy briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.

Does not break Stealth.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Daze replaced with a debuff that reduces damage against dismounted players.</rgb>

1879214597.name: Unerring Strike
1879214597.desc: A targeted strike that is very difficult to avoid and deals potent damage for a long time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879218437.name: Improved Song of Distraction
1879218437.desc: A song that can make an enemy, and up to two other enemies within ten metres of the first, become drowsy and not detect players until they are much closer than normal. This does not work against monsters already engaged in combat.

procEffects.description: Damaging skills have a  *  chance to make your next healing skill crit.
Scoring a Critical Hit increases Outgoing Healing by 10% for 10s. You cannot gain this effect more than once every 25s.

conditionalEffects.description: The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks once.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 2 times.
The Cauterizing Steel Gambit line will apply a 10% Incoming Healing debuff to the target. Stacks up to 3 times.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879251717.name: The Horn of Gondor
1879251717.desc: Boromir carries a horn with which he can summon aid during times of greatest need.

1879260037.name: Quick Shot: Elvish Arrow
1879260037.desc: Nock and loose an arrow quickly.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879263621.name: Lay Trap
1879263621.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.

1879276549.name: Rending Bark
1879276549.desc: Your sharp bark catches your enemies by surprise, opening up opportunities to strike.

1879291397.name: Healer's Strike
1879291397.desc: A melee attack that increases healing effects on yourself for a short time.\n\nRestores Morale of the Fellowship.

1879316485.name: Shadow Grim
1879316485.desc: Summons a shadow grim to your side. It is helpful during bright days.

1879329157.name: Guide to Minas Tirith
1879329157.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Minas Tirith.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879334661.name: Resist the Black Shadow
1879334661.desc: Held within the grip of the Black Shadow, Merry must resist its dark pull if he is to survive.

1879342469.name: Steed of the Moon Moth
1879342469.desc: A steed evoking the beauty of the moth.

1879358085.name: Blade Thrust
1879358085.desc: A damaging sword strike to a single enemy.

1879389957.name: Swift Jab
1879389957.desc: A simple punch often does the trick.

1879394565.name: Steed of the Autumn Traveller
1879394565.desc: A noble fallow deer dressed for the season.

1879405445.name: Goose
1879405445.desc: Summons a silly goose to keep you company.

1879442565.name: Call Kyrstig
1879442565.desc: Blow the horn to summon Kyrstig to your side.

1879457541.name: Unseen Strikes
1879457541.desc: A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.\n\nThis skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879458181.name: Adorable Sickle-fly
1879458181.desc: Summons an adorable sickle-fly to accompany you on your journeys.

1879458693.name: At the Fore
1879458693.desc: You are the first line of defence, facing down enemies directly and without fear.\n\nWhile active, you will build stacks of 'At the Fore' when hit by enemies.

1879466245.name: Sail to Trader's Wharf
1879466245.desc: Navigate to Trader's Wharf with nearby fellows.

1879479301.name: Sublime Piglet
1879479301.desc: Summons a sublime pet to accompany you on your travels.

1879508741.name: Sail to Zajâna
1879508741.desc: Navigate to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala with nearby fellows.
